item.text: {"search_note":"I found little direct evidence on pandemics or conflict displacement in 2024; the best evidence for crisis harm reduction is on disasters and economic shocks, not public-health emergencies.","evidence":[{"title":"PBBM orders activation of online platform to monitor El Niño, La Niña phenomena","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-03-26","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-orders-activation-of-online-platform-to-monitor-el-nino-la-nina-phenomena/","summary":"Marcos ordered a public dashboard to monitor El Niño/La Niña, show sector conditions and government interventions, and let citizens report observations. That is direct crisis-monitoring and early-warning infrastructure.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.5"]},{"title":"PBBM calls for comprehensive national flood-control plan to protect communities, production areas","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-07-26","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-calls-for-comprehensive-national-flood-control-plan-to-protect-communities-production-areas/","summary":"After Typhoon Carina and Habagat, Marcos ordered a national flood-control plan explicitly framed around protecting communities and production areas. This is strong evidence of disaster-loss reduction.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"PBBM responded to Tropical Storm Enteng’s effects in Rizal, says govt response working","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-09-06","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-satisfied-with-govt-response-to-tropical-storm-entengs-effects-in-rizal/","summary":"Marcos said the government’s response was working and stressed maintaining enough relief supplies for more storms. This supports a logistics-focused crisis response rather than neglect.","question_ids":["6B.6"]},{"title":"PBBM responds to flood crisis by ordering comprehensive national flood-control plan","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-07-26","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-calls-for-comprehensive-national-flood-control-plan-to-protect-communities-production-areas/","summary":"The same flood episode also shows the state reacting to serious vulnerability, which points to active mitigation even if it also reveals a governance gap.","question_ids":["6B.6"]},{"title":"PBBM orders swift assistance after Typhoon Carina","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-07-26","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-calls-for-comprehensive-national-flood-control-plan-to-protect-communities-production-areas/","summary":"Marcos ordered swift assistance after the storm, which is direct evidence of emergency relief aimed at reducing avoidable suffering.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"PBBM-admin made every effort to shield Filipinos from high food prices, keeps inflation within target in 2024","publisher":"Department of Finance","date":"2024-12-17","url":"https://www.dof.gov.ph/pbbm-admin-made-every-effort-to-shield-filipinos-from-high-food-prices-keeps-inflation-within-target-in-2024/","summary":"The administration says inflation ended 2024 at 3.2%, rice prices moderated, and low-income households benefited from interventions. This is positive year-end evidence of reduced economic suffering, though it is government self-assessment.","question_ids":["6B.6","5B.10","6B.2"]},{"title":"Philippines 2024 Article IV Consultation press release and staff report","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-12-19","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/12/17/pr-24478-philippines-imf-concludes-2024-article-iv-consultation","summary":"IMF said the authorities handled external headwinds well, growth stayed resilient, inflation averaged 3.2%, and gradual fiscal consolidation was underway. This is the best independent high-level evidence that Marcos reduced macroeconomic stress by year-end.","question_ids":["6B.6","5B.10"]},{"title":"Rice inflation hit a 15-year high in March as rice soars","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-04-04","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/philippine-inflation-quickens-again-in-march-as-rice-soars-3366872","summary":"Early 2024 food suffering was severe: rice inflation hit a 15-year high and the BSP stayed tight. This is the clearest counterevidence to any claim of quick crisis relief.","question_ids":["6B.6","5B.9","5B.10"]},{"title":"NEDA reduced rice tariffs failed to lower prices","publisher":"GMA News Online","date":"2024-12-10","url":"https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/money/economy/929579/neda-reduced-rice-tariffs-failed-to-lower-prices/story/","summary":"NEDA said the tariff cut did not lower retail rice prices as anticipated, so the flagship food-relief intervention had only partial success. This is strong evidence of limited short-run suffering reduction.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.2","5B.9"]},{"title":"NEDA: tariff cut could be tweaked if conditions change","publisher":"Philippine News Agency","date":"2024-06-24","url":"https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1227544","summary":"NEDA said the rice tariff policy was under periodic review and could be adjusted as conditions changed. This shows the administration had a correction mechanism, even if outcomes were mixed.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.5"]},{"title":"Marcos expands 4Ps to pregnant, lactating women to improve children’s health, well-being","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-06-11","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-orders-4ps-expansion-to-cover-pregnant-lactating-women-to-ensure-childrens-health-well-being-in-first-1000-days/","summary":"Expanding 4Ps to pregnant and lactating women is targeted crisis-prevention against malnutrition and early-life hardship. It reduces avoidable suffering for mothers and children in a structural way.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"PBBM fosters PWD-friendly Philippines","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-07-23","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-fosters-pwd-friendly-philippines/","summary":"Marcos announced PWD interventions and PhilHealth benefits for PWD children and senior citizens. This is targeted protection that lowers vulnerability during household and health shocks.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.3"]},{"title":"PBBM approves one-stop system for child rights violations","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-12-10","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-okays-one-stop-system-for-reporting-child-rights-violations/","summary":"MAKABATA centralizes reporting and support for abused, neglected, exploited, trafficked, disabled, and HIV-affected children. That is direct suffering-reduction infrastructure for a highly vulnerable group.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.3"]},{"title":"Marcos bans all POGOs after citing torture, kidnapping, trafficking, and murder","publisher":"GMA News Online","date":"2024-07-22","url":"https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/914272/marcos-announces-ban-on-all-pogo/story/","summary":"The POGO ban is not a classic natural-disaster response, but it did reduce exposure to a violent exploitation network that was causing severe suffering.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"The U.S. State Department report says the Marcos administration shifted drug policy toward treatment, due process, and rule-of-law investigations","publisher":"U.S. Department of State via ecoi.net","date":"2024","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128580.html","summary":"The shift away from Duterte-style arbitrary violence likely reduced avoidable suffering in poor communities, though abuses continued. This is partial, not comprehensive, crisis-harm reduction.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.1","6B.2"]},{"title":"HRW 2025 World Report: Philippines","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2025-01-16","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/philippines","summary":"HRW says killings, disappearances, and political violence persisted in 2024, showing that suffering from state-related abuse was not eliminated. This is important negative context.","question_ids":["6B.6"]},{"title":"HRW: red-tagging left activists and critics at serious risk","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/philippines-red-tagging-puts-activists-risk","summary":"HRW’s red-tagging reporting is negative background evidence that some vulnerable groups still faced coercive pressure even outside classic disaster crises.","question_ids":["6B.6","6B.3"]}]}
